title: Animated Dropdown Menu
subtitle: A menu of actions or options that opens from a button.
panelClass: flex min-h-[60vh] items-start justify-center p-[3vw] max-md:p-[5vw]

descriptions.animation: How the menu opens: collapse, slide, scale, reveal or morph.
descriptions.exitFast: The menu closes faster than it opens.
descriptions.duration: How long the open animation takes, in seconds.
descriptions.delay: Wait before the menu starts opening, in seconds.
descriptions.stagger: Delay between each item appearing, in seconds.
descriptions.itemHighlight: How the highlight moves between items: slides, fills from the top, or none.
descriptions.selectionIndicator: Mark shown on the chosen item: check, dot or bar.
descriptions.showDescriptions: Shows a short description under each item.
descriptions.rollingText: Item labels roll to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.icon: Icon on the trigger: plus that turns to minus, or a chevron.
descriptions.rollingValue: The chosen value in the trigger rolls to the new one when it changes.
descriptions.openOnHover: Opens the menu when you hover the trigger, not only on click.
descriptions.closeDelayOnSelect: Waits a moment after a pick so you see the selection before the menu closes.
descriptions.typeahead: With the menu open, typing a letter moves the highlight to the first item starting with it (P jumps to Paused). Off: letter keys do nothing.
